title: State balance with the Union, two-step rule (GD16), 2025-01 to 2025-12
rule: Federal spending: UF of the budget localizer when the file has one; otherwise the Union (D114), except the payroll divisions of the former territories (AP, RO, RR), which count in their state. Unemployment insurance and wage bonus: UF of the localizer when present, otherwise without a state (no official monthly series by state; GD16). Other branches by the seat of the unit. Transfers, Bolsa Família, INSS, BPC and FCDF by destination. Interest and amortization out.
sign: balance > 0: the state sends more than it receives; balance < 0: it receives more than it sends

check.unemployment_and_wage_bonus_rule: localizer UF where present, otherwise without a state (no official series by state)
check.tesouro_minus_portal_executive_note: The Tesouro base carries court-ordered payments (sentenças judiciais) and a residue the Portal file does not; they stay without a state.

sent.official_total_source: Receita Federal, arrecadação total (Análise da Arrecadação, Tabela III, e série 1994 a 2025)

returned.official_total_source: Tesouro Nacional, RTN Tabela 1.1, linha 2 (transferências por repartição de receita) mais linha 4 (despesa total)
